job.job_description:
Greetings from SwaaS!




Role: Moveworks AI Engineer

Experience: 5+ years

Location: Guindy, Chennai




JD:

Hands-on experience with Moveworks Agent Studio, plugins, AI Assistant configuration, or similar conversational AI automation platforms.
Exposure to ServiceNow ITSM/CSM, Workday APIs/WQL, Nexthink, and related enterprise workflows and integrations.
Experience with Microsoft Teams/M365, SharePoint/OneDrive/Outlook, Azure AD/Entra ID, SSO, and RBAC concepts.
Exposure to Snowflake, Power BI, data/analytics pipelines, and scripting using Python, JavaScript, PowerShell, or similar technologies.
Strong understanding of LLM/RAG, enterprise search, knowledge grounding, intent classification, AI governance, and prompt/response optimization; relevant certifications are an advantage.




Interested candidates can share their resumes at hr@swaas.net
